Evacuation Update as of September 26, 2025 | 9:00 PM

Bilang pag-iingat sa pagbaha na sanhi ng mga pag-ulan dulot ng Bagyong #OpongPH, mayroong itinalagang evacuation sites sa mga piling lugar na bahain o may banta ng landslide para sa ligtas at mabilis na paglikas.

Sa kasalukuyan, nasa 2,238 pamilya o 8,095 indibidwal ang inilikas at namamalagi sa evacuation sites sa ating lungsod. 

Para sa emergency, tumawag sa Quezon City HELPLINE 122.

Heavy Rainfall Warning No. 8 #NCR_PRSD
Weather System: Severe Tropical Storm OPONG
Issued at: 11:00 PM, 26 September 2025(Friday)

YELLOW WARNING LEVEL: Batangas(Calatagan, Lian, Balayan, Nasugbu, Tuy, Calaca, Lemery, Mabini, Tingloy, Bauan, San Luis, Taal, Agoncillo, Santa Teresita, San Nicolas, Laurel).
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: FLOODING in flood-prone areas.
Meanwhile, expect light to moderate rains over Rizal, Bulacan, Pampanga, Nueva Ecija and Tarlac within the next 3 hours.
Light to moderate with occasional heavy rains affecting Cavite, Bataan, Batangas(Balete, Batangas City, Tanauan, Cuenca, Ibaan, Lipa, Lobo, Malvar, Mataasnakahoy, Padre Garcia, Rosario, San Jose, San Juan, Santo Tomas, Talisay, Taysan, San Pascual, Alitagtag), Metro Manila(Pasay, Paranaque, Muntinlupa, Las Pinas, Taguig), Laguna(San Pedro, Binan, Santa Rosa, Cabuyao, Calamba, San Pablo, Alaminos, Calauan, Los Banos, Bay), Quezon(San Francisco, San Andres, San Narciso, Mulanay, Catanauan, Buenavista, Lopez, Guinayangan, Tagkawayan, Calauag, Macalelon, General Luna, Pitogo, San Antonio, Tiaong, Candelaria, Sariaya, Lucena, Pagbilao, Padre Burgos, Agdangan, Unisan, Gumaca, Plaridel, Atimonan, Quezon, Alabat, Perez, Dolores) and Zambales(Olongapo, Subic, Castillejos, San Antonio, San Narciso, San Felipe, San Marcelino) which may persist within 3 hours and may affect nearby areas.

The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are advised to MONITOR the weather condition and watch for the next warning to be issued at 2:00 AM tomorrow.
For more information and queries, please call telephone numbers 8927-1335 and 8927-2877 or log on to https://t.co/59mTpZJq1n.
